reporter_profiles.algorithm_summary: Outer-held-out probabilities are aggregated to participant OOF; BA, macro-F1, one-vs-rest ROC/PR AUC, per-class metrics, confusion, calibration, repeat variability, confidence intervals and paired inference are reported from persisted predictions.
limitations: A P value is a null-model tail probability, not the probability that a model is correct or superior.
Overlapping marginal 95% CIs are descriptive and are not a paired significance test.
Tuning/screening evidence is not an untouched independent final test.
literature: Brodersen et al. (2010), balanced accuracy, DOI:10.1109/ICPR.2010.764
Sokolova & Lapalme (2009), classification measures including F-score, DOI:10.1016/j.ipm.2009.03.002
Efron & Tibshirani (1993), An Introduction to the Bootstrap, DOI:10.1007/978-1-4899-4541-9
Holm (1979), sequentially rejective multiple testing, DOI:10.2307/4615733
statistical_methods: Participant-level metrics are recomputed separately within each repeat.
Repeat summaries use mean, sample/population SD and two-sided Student-t 95% CI.
Student-t intervals are descriptive across repeats and are not clipped to [0,1]; they rely on a small-sample parametric approximation even though repeated-CV estimates are correlated.

When persisted config-metrics are available, BA and macro-F1 use stratified participant-cluster percentile bootstrap resampling; count and seed are configurable (default 10,000), and the actual values/method version must be persisted in the output table.

Declared-reference comparisons use paired participant-cluster permutations with Holm correction separately for BA and macro-F1; count and seed are configurable (default 100,000), and the actual values/method version must be persisted in the inference table.
Permutation tables persist the implementation version and NumPy row-wise int8 RNG contract so same-seed historical rebuilds remain auditable.

Multiclass ROC uses empirical one-vs-rest curves plus a macro-average interpolation. The ROC figure pools persisted participant-repeat OOF rows for visualization; inferential AUC summaries remain repeat-wise and preserve their dependence labels. t-SNE is report-only on probability vectors.
reporter_profiles.title: Multiclass frailty classifier

Repeat t-CI and participant-cluster percentile CI are reported separately; marginal CI overlap is not used as a significance test.
8 candidate contrasts use declared_reference_confirmatory paired participant-cluster P values with metric-wise Holm correction.
Worst-fold BA=44.4%; worst-class F1=50.0%. These stress metrics can disagree with mean BA ranking.
